Hilton has named the nine hotels it expects to open across Europe, the Middle East and Africa in 2027, spread over seven countries. The list was published on 17 November 2026, and one address stands well above the others: Admiralty Arch, at the end of The Mall in London.

## A landmark facing Buckingham Palace

Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch occupies a Grade I-listed monument directly opposite Buckingham Palace. The building is being restored and reimagined by Reuben Brothers in partnership with Hilton. It will offer 114 rooms, suites and residences, a ballroom and a range of smaller event spaces. The opening is expected early in 2027.

## Two chef names on the door

Food carries the project. Clare Smyth, the chef behind Core in Notting Hill, leads Coreus. Daniel Boulud brings Café Boulud to London. The bar line-up adds Whiskey & Seaweed, a cocktail bar, and The Admiral's Mess, a nod to the building's naval past.

## The Mediterranean and the Alps

Most of the other European openings sit by the sea. Conrad Corfu is due in spring 2027 with 136 rooms, suites and villas, many with private pools or jacuzzis, on around 200 metres of private beach on the Ionian Sea. Its signature menu is signed by Michelin-starred chef Alexandros Tsiotinis.

On the Sorrento coast, Majestic Palace Sorrento, Curio Collection by Hilton, opens 76 rooms within a private garden of about 10,000 m². It keeps the Michelin-starred restaurant Don Geppi and adds the Dry Martini Rooftop.

In Switzerland, Waldhaus Flims Grand Resort & Spa, a hotel that has received guests since 1877, joins the Curio Collection with 143 rooms and access to more than 235 km of ski slopes. Greece also gets Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa and PHĀEA Mitato Crete, while Croatia gets Hilton Lopud Beach Resort & Spa near Dubrovnik. Beyond Europe, LXR Casablanca is planned for summer 2027.

## The signal

The large groups are now competing for trophy buildings and star chefs as much as for new locations. At Admiralty Arch, the history of the building and the names of Clare Smyth and Daniel Boulud are the offer. For London's luxury market, already crowded around Mayfair and Westminster, 2027 opens with one more landmark address to watch.
summary: Hilton names nine EMEA openings for 2027. Waldorf Astoria London – Admiralty Arch, facing Buckingham Palace, leads with 114 keys and restaurants by Clare Smyth and Daniel Boulud, ahead of Conrad Corfu and Majestic Palace Sorrento.
title: Admiralty Arch leads Hilton's 2027 openings in Europe
why: A Grade I landmark facing Buckingham Palace, two star chefs and a Mediterranean pipeline.
